reason: This plugin is primarily a clipboard utility: it tracks system clipboard changes, maintains a local searchable history, and exposes both a web panel and Agent tools for clipboard and history operations. Evidence in the repository description and README consistently centers on practical clipboard management and history interaction (search/copy/delete), with no core behavior aligned to code generation, testing, analysis, or research categories.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于监控系统剪贴板并在会话中保留可搜索的剪贴板历史记录，提供面板用于检索、复制和删除条目，并通过 Agent 工具支持读取、搜索、写入与删除剪贴板数据。
summaries.en: This plugin monitors the system clipboard, keeps a searchable local history, and exposes a DSH web panel plus Agent tools for retrieving, searching, copying, and deleting clipboard items.

capabilities: agent tool access to clipboard operations

reasons.code: Repository README states the plugin continuously monitors system clipboard content and stores it in ~/.dsh/clipboard-history.json with a 500-item limit.
README and package metadata indicate a web panel for searching, copying, deleting entries, pause/resume monitoring, and clearing history.
The plugin registers Agent tools clipboard_get, clipboard_history_search, clipboard_copy, and clipboard_history_delete for model-driven clipboard actions.

capabilities: agent tool access to clipboard operations
